subject: Computer Networks
chapters: Data Link Layer and Local Area Networks

questions.text: Suppose a company has an assigned network IP address 150.10.0.0/16 (or 202.35.91.32/25) with 6 departments containing 1010, 505, 225, 107, 60, and 45 hosts. As a network engineer, design an IP addressing plan using Variable Length Subnet Masking (VLSM). List out the CIDR prefix, subnet mask, network ID, broadcast ID, usable host IP address range, and number of wasted IP addresses for each department.

Compare the OSI 7-layer reference model with the TCP/IP protocol suite. Discuss the functions, protocols, and data units (PDUs) at each layer, and explain the key design issues in layering: encapsulation, addressing, and multiplexing.

questions.chapter: Data Link Layer and Local Area Networks
questions.text: Compare byte stuffing and bit stuffing in framing. A received frame is 0101101101 and the generator polynomial is G(x) = x^3 + 1 (or 1001). Check whether the received bit sequence contains transmission errors using Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC). Show the complete modulo-2 division steps.

Compare TCP and UDP header formats and functionalities. How is a connection established and terminated in TCP using the three-way handshake? How is congestion handled using the Token Bucket and Leaky Bucket algorithms? Explain with block diagrams.

Explain why Domain Name System (DNS) is hierarchical and distributed in nature. Differentiate between Iterative DNS query and Recursive DNS query with a step-by-step resolution diagram for www.facebook.com. What is the role of a proxy server and web caching?

Describe the CIA (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability) security principle. Explain the RSA public-key cryptographic algorithm step-by-step. Encrypt the plaintext word 'virus' (or 'hacker', 'MACHINE') using RSA given prime numbers p, q, and encryption key e.

What are the features of the IPv6 base header compared to the IPv4 header? Explain IPv4 to IPv6 transition mechanisms: Dual Stack, Tunneling (6to4, 4to6, configured tunnels), and Network Address Translation - Protocol Translation (NAT-PT).

Differentiate between Distance Vector Routing and Link State Routing algorithms. Explain the working principle of Routing Information Protocol (RIP) with its timers. What is the Count-to-Infinity problem in distance vector routing and how is it resolved using Split Horizon with Poison Reverse?

What factors are considered when selecting transmission media? Explain the construction, propagation characteristics, advantages, and disadvantages of Optical Fiber cables (Single-mode vs Multi-mode). Compare FDM, TDM, and WDM multiplexing techniques.

questions.chapter: Data Link Layer and Local Area Networks
questions.text: What is a Virtual LAN (VLAN)? Explain the advantages of VLANs and how frame tagging is implemented according to the IEEE 802.1Q standard. Differentiate between static and dynamic VLANs.

Draw the architecture of an Electronic Mail system showing User Agents (UA), Message Transfer Agents (MTA), and Message Access Agents (MAA). Compare Post Office Protocol (POP3) and Internet Message Access Protocol (IMAP).

questions.chapter: Data Link Layer and Local Area Networks
questions.text: Compare Stop-and-Wait ARQ, Go-Back-N ARQ, and Selective Repeat ARQ sliding window protocols. Calculate maximum throughput and line efficiency for a given transmission rate, frame size, and round-trip propagation delay.

Explain IP Security (IPSec) architecture: Authentication Header (AH) vs Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP), and Transport Mode vs Tunnel Mode. Differentiate between Packet-Filtering Firewalls and Application-Level Gateways.

questions.chapter: Data Link Layer and Local Area Networks
questions.text: Explain the Medium Access Control (MAC) protocol CSMA/CD used in Ethernet and CSMA/CA used in IEEE 802.11 wireless networks. Why is collision detection not feasible in wireless transmissions?

Explain how the Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) resolves an IP address to a physical MAC address with request and reply frame structures. What is the role of ICMP and how is it used in ping and traceroute diagnostics?
Explain HTTP request methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) and HTTP status code categories (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx). Compare persistent HTTP with pipelining versus non-persistent HTTP connections.
